title: Charge Card
description: Billing asks Stripe to take the week's price from the household's saved card; a successful charge licenses week-charged, a decline pauses the subscription and releases the week.

subscriptionId.description: The subscription being charged; billing sends its own id, never Stripe's customer id.

week.description: ISO-8601 week being paid for, e.g. 2026-W36; sent with subscriptionId as the idempotency key.

amount.description: The week's price in GBP minor units (pence), an integer and never a float: 3450 is £34.50. Connect's payload carries no currency field — the PaymentGateway adapter sets GBP on every charge (assumption A1).

currency.description: 1.0 bills in GBP only. Pinned rather than described so a non-GBP week fails here instead of at Stripe.
